name: Which city has the toughest feasibility process?

mainEntity.name: Are construction feasibility assessments harder in Los Angeles than in Glendale, Pasadena, Burbank, or North Hollywood?
mainEntity.text: Are construction feasibility assessments harder in Los Angeles than in Glendale, Pasadena, Burbank, or North Hollywood?

acceptedAnswer.text: The difficulty depends more on the site than the city name alone, but Los Angeles often creates the most moving parts because of its scale and the variety of neighborhood conditions. Glendale, Pasadena, Burbank, and North Hollywood each have their own local review patterns, zoning standards, and site-specific challenges. The right way to compare them is not by assuming one city is always easier, but by asking which approvals, reports, and constraints are likely on your exact lot. A feasibility assessment should be local enough to account for the jurisdiction, neighborhood context, and property conditions. That is especially important when properties sit near hillside areas, older neighborhoods, or lots with limited access. The more specific the report is to the city and parcel, the more useful it becomes for decision-making.
acceptedAnswer.description: Los Angeles often has the most complex feasibility process because of its size, varied zoning conditions, and many overlay areas. That said, Glendale, Pasadena, Burbank, and nearby neighborhoods can also create difficult feasibility issues through local design review, hillside constraints, and lot-specific permitting requirements.
